In 1943, Leas was proclaimed the “wolf king” of Alberta for having trapped the largest number of wolves. Leas left Swan Hills in 1960 to return home to Michigan, and the abandoned cabin served as a campsite for various forestry crews. In 1977, the Swan Hills Chamber of Commerce undertook the site as a community project, and spent the next four years"}
